        "Full two-file owned production/test diff read. The dragstart listener resolves the auto-tree row, changes selectedIndex only when that row is outside selectedIndices and calls the observer afterward. The observer reads current selected rows, addresses and card into transferable flavors, so changing selection after that call would be too late. Dragging an already selected row preserves its existing multiselection.",

The new scalar assertion has a nonempty message containing should; checkPills uses a nonempty deep-equality message. The helper ends each drag session.
